selected_script.angle: Absurd scuba-diver grandma rescuing a chaotic overflowing winter closet with the cordless vacuum bag pump
selected_script.hook: Close-up of huge fluffy winter coats uncontrollably spilling out of an overstuffed closet shelf

timeline: 0-1.5s: Show close-up of massive fluffy winter coats uncontrollably spilling out of an overstuffed home closet shelf. No product and no rescuer.
1.5-3s: An absurd adult family rescuer (Grandma wearing full scuba diving gear) enters carrying the exact product, goes directly to the chaotic closet, and says 'Watch and learn.'
3-6s: Quickly show the white portable cylindrical air pump placed on the dark grey valve of the clear honeycomb bag, shrinking a huge coat instantly.
6-10s: Fast-cut scene 1 showing the first clear result: a perfectly flat, stiff, completely vacuum-sealed bag.
10-14s: Fast-cut scene 2 showing the flat honeycomb-patterned clear bag being easily slid into a small storage box under a bed.
14-18s: Fast-cut scene 3 showing a beautifully organized, spacious home closet with multiple flat clear bags stacked neatly.
18-20s: Short CTA text overlay 'Maximize your space today.'

final_moyin_jobs.promptText: Create a 10-second vertical UGC ad video. Timeline: 0-1.5s: Show one real daily pain point through a close-up detail of massive fluffy winter coats uncontrollably spilling out of an overstuffed home closet shelf. No product and no rescuer. 1.5-3s: An absurd adult family rescuer (an elderly Grandma wearing full scuba diving gear) enters carrying the exact product from the first frame, takes it directly to the pain-point position at the closet, and says one short 3-word English line 'Watch and learn'. 3-6s: Quickly show the product as the direct solution. Show the white portable cylindrical air pump with its single grey power button attached to the dark grey suction valve of the clear honeycomb mesh patterned plastic bag, rapidly sucking the air out and shrinking a huge coat. 6-10s: Fast-cut scene 1 showing the first clear result of a perfectly flat, compressed bag with the double zipper seal tightly closed. Do not start with a perfect product shot. Do not end with a CTA in this segment. Keep the pacing fast, clear, low-risk, and product-focused. Use the provided product reference images as the exact product identity. Do not change the product color, shape, material, size ratio, logo position, texture, or visible structure. Do not invent extra accessories, buttons, lights, packaging, or exaggerated functions. Use the detail and side reference image to preserve product material, side structure, edge shape, texture, and visible details. Use the function reference image only to understand the real product usage. Do not invent new functions.
